clips.title: The story
paras: Near Auberdine’s docks and inn in Darkshore, Cerellean Whiteclaw rests with grief for a lost love. The Sundering’s memory haunts him, and he struggles to bring that restless spirit peace.

Before the War of the Ancients, Cerellean Whiteclaw shared his life with Anaya Dawnrunner. Ten thousand years ago, the demonic invasion shattered ancient Kalimdor, and Anaya died in the destruction of her city, Ameth'Aran. Stricken with grief, Cerellean followed Malfurion Stormrage into the long druidic slumber. The Emerald Dream brought little relief from his memories. When he awoke millennia later, he wandered Darkshore in grief and found Anaya's ghost still bound to the stones where she fell.
